head: Wowie turns the iPhone Duo into a gift box that opens when unfolded
dek: Wowie lets you fill a virtual gift box on your iPhone, write a note on the lid and hand the phone over; on an iPhone Duo the box opens when the other person unfolds it. It costs $1.99 and was #95 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 14 November.
details: You pick what's inside, from a ring or chocolates to an award plaque, a fortune cookie or Halloween scares, and choose the box's style and decoration. On other iPhones a shake opens the box. Made by Berke Keser, out since 31 October; the listing says there are no ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases. It needs iOS 27.
means: If you have an iPhone Duo, this is a small way to surprise someone with a message; it works on other iPhones with a shake.
todo: Find Wowie: Surprise Gift Box in the App Store; it's a one-time $1.99.
